name: ui-agent-chat-desktop
description: UIWarden (ui-agent-chat) desktop client — 在用户本机运行 server 与浏览器执行环境
author: UIWarden

scripts.pack:mac: npm --prefix .. run build && npm --prefix .. run prepare:ui-test-runtime -- --platform=darwin --arch=$(node -p 'process.arch') && node scripts/prepare-package.cjs && node scripts/mac-icon.cjs build && electron-builder --mac dir --config electron-builder.json && bash scripts/sign-local-app.sh release/mac-$(node -p 'process.arch')/UIWarden.app && bash scripts/create-local-dmg.sh release/mac-$(node -p 'process.arch')/UIWarden.app release/UIWarden-${npm_package_version}-$(node -p 'process.arch').dmg "UIWarden ${npm_package_version}" && bash scripts/verify-install-dmg.sh release/UIWarden-${npm_package_version}-$(node -p 'process.arch').dmg
scripts.pack:win: npm --prefix .. run build && npm --prefix .. run prepare:ui-test-runtime -- --platform=win32 --arch=x64 && node scripts/prepare-package.cjs && electron-builder --win nsis --config electron-builder.json
